evidence.title: Get the Hemingway Editor for Mac and PC
Free Readability Checker App | Check readability score of your text

name: Hemingway Editor
summary: Writing editor that highlights wordy sentences, adverbs, passive voice and readability problems in your text.
description: Type or paste prose and the editor marks dead weight — wordy sentences in yellow, more egregious ones in red, adverbs, passive voice and complicated words — with a readability grade. Hemingway Editor Plus adds AI rewriting, grammar fixes, eight tone styles, synonyms and document review on a subscription after a 2-week trial; the classic Mac/Windows app is a $19.99 one-time purchase, and free online checkers cover readability, grammar, paraphrasing and proofreading.
contains: highlights wordy sentences (yellow/red), adverbs, passive voice and complicated words
readability grade and text formatting; publishes to WordPress
Plus plans: Individual 5K $100/year, Individual 10K $150/year, Team 10K, Enterprise
desktop app Hemingway Editor 3 for Mac and PC at $19.99, no AI features
2-week free trial without a credit card
free online readability checker, grammar checker, paraphrasing tool and proofreader
exports HTML, Markdown, Word, PDF and text; imports .docx
